prompt: Write a method that computes the Hamming distance between two equal-length strings, or -1 if the lengths differ. Complete the hammingDistance method in the starter file, then run the tests.
explanation: Hamming distance is a position-by-position comparison, so a single index drives lookups into both strings at once -- a common pattern when walking two sequences in parallel. Checking the length mismatch first is essential: without it, indexing past the end of the shorter string would throw a StringIndexOutOfBoundsException. Using -1 as the mismatch signal works because a real distance can never be negative.
hints: Check the lengths first and return -1 when they differ -- that also protects the loop from running off the shorter string.
Use one loop index i and compare a.charAt(i) with b.charAt(i).
Count the positions where the characters differ and return the count.
